text: Communication engineering is a discipline that studies information transmission, switching, processing and communication system design, aiming to cultivate professional talents with a solid foundation in communication theory, system design capabilities and engineering practice experience. Students are required to master core knowledge such as signal processing, network architecture, and communication protocols, and be capable of engaging in research and development, design, operation and maintenance, or scientific research in fields like 5G/6G, Internet of Things, satellite communication, and information security.
